changelog: Builds the no-TRIAC Release-One configuration while Sense360 TRIAC remains blocked pending hardware verification.
Excludes Sense360 LED because the WebFlash config string does not include `LED`.
known_issues: Sense360 TRIAC / FanTRIAC is not included in this Release-One firmware.
Sense360 TRIAC remains blocked until S360-320 schematic and direct GPIO/timing requirements are verified.
VentIQ schematic verification is still pending; this build uses the current package-level VentIQ configuration.
hardware_requirements: No Sense360 TRIAC module for this Release-One firmware.
No Sense360 LED module for this Release-One firmware.
